Messages.Author: David Wilson, Mask of a Thousand Names
Messages.Body:
Hey Norm,

Interesting deck. Have you played it yet? It 'feels' like it would
jam a little. Is the Trophy Discipline for Basillia to get Dominate or
perhaps Lambach to get Potence? I would think you would be better off
putting in another Trophy Progeny. Have you thought about using only
Lambach and his ADV to get that silly, silly Eye, he can then Have your
potence, and a rush. You aren't taking many multiple actions, but with
only Lambach, you could use Horrid Form and his inherrent aggro strike
to burn. It would eliminate the Scorpion Sting, which I think is a
little less necessary with Immortal Grapple. I will post a draft of
what I mean here.

David

Messages.Author: David Wilson, Mask of a Thousand Names
Messages.Body:
Hey Norm,

Here is a quick draft based on your deck above, let me know what you
think

Deck Name : Lambach Redlist
Author : David Wilson
Description :
Your Non-Lambach Minions can Red List weenies controlled by your
prey/predator, if Blocked, they can Immortal Grapple and Pushing the
Limits to drop exta damage. The idea of the distributed titles is to
take the load off of Lambach, the couple embraces should help your
forward pressure, and perhaps Lambach can use his wierd special. The
Immortal Grapple, Big Game and Telepathic Tracking should allow you to
use the Horrid Form more effectively.
